notes: παντὶ τῷ ἔχοντι falls under rule 80's second arm (a second English word written for the article), so the pair splits: 'every' to the quantifier, 'one' to the article, 'that hath' to the participle.
The case preposition 'unto' is kept contiguous with the quantifier; attaching it to the article under rule 21 remains the competing reading.
